paragraphs.en: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist , a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint, executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy ( 74.7 % 74.7\% vs. 74.0 % 74.0\% ) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

paragraphs.en: There is no reason it has to stay that way. The prompts and reasoning procedures that put a model to work are text and code, and agents themselves have become good at writing both. What humans do to design (write, try, adjust) such inference strategies is the natural agentic loop. Such loops have already been shown to evolve programs far beyond their starting point ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , and AI scientists now run the same loop end to end ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Gottweis et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . Designing an inference strategy is the same work with a different object. So why not evolve agentic reasoning itself the same way? Run on far more cases than a person could try, the loop could outdo what people build by hand.
paragraphs.zh: 没有理由它必须一直保持那样。 让模型运转起来的提示词与推理过程都是文本和代码，而智能体本身已经擅长撰写这两者。 人类为设计（编写、尝试、调整）这类推理策略所做的事情，正是天然的智能体循环。 这类循环已被证明能够将程序演化到远超其起点（Novikov 等，2025），而如今 AI 科学家已经端到端地运行同样的循环（Lu 等，2024；Gottweis 等，2025；Yamada 等，2025）。 设计推理策略是同样的工作，只是对象不同。 那么，为什么不以同样的方式演化智能体推理本身呢？ 在远超人力所能尝试的案例规模上运行，这个循环可能胜过人们手工构建的成果。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to automate this loop: searching over strategy designs, as raw code or as assemblies of fixed components ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; training controllers that route each input to an existing strategy ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Su et al., 2025 ) ; or optimizing one strategy per task by training, evolution, or iterative refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . All of them beat hand-designed strategies on individual benchmarks, and all of them stop there. Searching or routing over a fixed set of strategies can never discover a new one. Trained optimizers need to start over for every task. These methods make the design automatic. We want to make it cumulative (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 最近的工作已经开始将这一循环自动化：在策略设计上进行搜索，可以是原始代码形式，也可以是固定组件的组合（Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c；Shang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）；训练控制器，将每个输入路由到已有策略（Taparia et al., 2026；Yue et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025b；Su et al., 2025）；或者通过训练、演化或迭代精炼为每个任务优化一个策略（Gao et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025a）。 这些方法在各自单独的基准测试上都击败了手工设计的策略，但也都止步于此。 在固定策略集合上搜索或路由，永远无法发现新的策略。 训练得到的优化器需要为每个任务从头再来。 这些方法使设计过程实现了自动化。 我们要让它实现累积式进步（Figure 2）。

paragraphs.en: We start from the representation. Evolving strategies needs a form open enough to express any reasoning procedure and structured enough for later searches to reuse and combine. We introduce the Strategy Blueprint : an executable program with one shared code interface, so any blueprint can serve as a component inside another. New designs are built from old ones, and the library grows as it is used.

paragraphs.en: On this representation we build Strategist , a meta-agent that does not answer questions but designs the strategies that do. It runs the write, try, adjust loop at scale, with frozen models and no training. Given a task and a small development set, it writes candidate strategies as blueprints, runs them on real samples, reads the traces, and revises them against measured accuracy and cost. Before each round it queries a shared library for relevant blueprints and for diverse ones as inspiration. After each round every candidate goes back into the library with its measurements and experience notes.

paragraphs.en: On 30 benchmarks spanning math, code, commonsense, multi-hop QA, knowledge, logic, and recommendation, we compare Strategist against 18 baselines. Strategist wins on 24 of 30, matching the strongest baseline’s average accuracy ( 74.0 % → 74.7 % 74.0\%\!\to\!74.7\% ) at 39% lower cost. The library pays off on its own: on 10 held-out benchmarks, retrieval with no search stays within 2 points of the strongest baseline on all 10 and beats it on 8 ( 77.8 % → 81.4 % 77.8\%\to 81.4\% ). The same strategies, moved to GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 without changing a line, still beat the baselines there. Each task solved leaves the next one a better place to start. Until now, only the model in an AI system could learn. Now the rest of it can too.

paragraphs.en: Every inference strategy, ultimately, is a program. How it is represented determines what an automated designer can build, test, and reuse. Existing work represents strategies as computation graphs ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) and declarative pipelines ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) , which are composable but can only express pre-defined patterns, or as monolithic code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , which can express anything but produces isolated strategies. We introduce the Strategy Blueprint : a reasoning flow that specifies how to solve a task (which models to call, in what order, at which tier, and how) using the open interface of code. Every blueprint exposes the same interface, so any can call any other, and a library can grow by composition.
paragraphs.zh: 任何推理策略，归根结底都是一个程序。 它的表示方式决定了自动化设计者能够构建、测试和复用什么。 已有工作将策略表示为计算图（Wu et al., 2024；Zhuge et al., 2024）和声明式流水线（Khattab et al., 2024；Yue et al., 2026），它们可组合但只能表达预定义的模式；或者表示为单体代码（Hu et al., 2025），它可以表达任何东西，但产生的是彼此孤立的策略。 我们提出策略蓝图（Strategy Blueprint）：一种以代码这一开放接口来规定如何解决任务的推理流程（调用哪些模型、以何种顺序、在哪个层级以及如何调用）。 每个蓝图都暴露相同的接口，因此任何蓝图都可以调用其他蓝图，库可以通过组合不断增长。

sents.en: We introduce the Strategy Blueprint : a reasoning flow that specifies how to solve a task (which models to call, in what order, at which tier, and how) using the open interface of code.
sents.zh: 我们提出策略蓝图（Strategy Blueprint）：一种以代码这一开放接口来规定如何解决任务的推理流程（调用哪些模型、以何种顺序、在哪个层级以及如何调用）。

sents.en: Every blueprint exposes the same interface, so any can call any other, and a library can grow by composition.
sents.zh: 每个蓝图都暴露相同的接口，因此任何蓝图都可以调用其他蓝图，库可以通过组合不断增长。

paragraphs.en: A blueprint is a Python program that captures the structure of a reasoning strategy without the task-specific prompts. For example, one blueprint defines a loop: generate three candidate answers, review each, then majority-vote. Filling in prompts produces a runnable strategy . It has one interface, execute(llm, task) -> str , and is built from two foundations: chat (single- or multi-turn conversation) and agent (with scaffold and tools). See Figure 4 for an example.
paragraphs.zh: 蓝图是一个 Python 程序，它捕获推理策略的结构，而不包含任务特定的提示词。 例如，一个蓝图定义了一个循环：生成三个候选答案，逐一审查，然后进行多数投票。 填入提示词后即可生成一个可运行的策略。 它只有一个接口 execute(llm, task) -> str，并由两个基础构件组成：chat（单轮或多轮对话）和智能体（带有脚手架和工具）。 示例见图 4。

paragraphs.en: We allow strategies to route across three model tiers ( fast , balanced , complex ), each in two modes ( nothink and thinking ), mirroring the tiered pricing and effort levels of common model providers. Not every reasoning step needs the same intelligence, so each step can target a different tier. This internal routing is what allows a single strategy to be accurate and cost-efficient at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们允许策略在三个模型层级（快速、均衡、复杂）之间路由，每个层级有两种模式（nothink 和 thinking），这与常见模型提供商的分级定价和努力水平相呼应。 并非每个推理步骤都需要同样的智能，因此每个步骤可以指向不同的层级。 正是这种内部路由，使得单个策略能够同时兼顾准确性和成本效率。

paragraphs.en: Blueprints live in a shared library that grows over time. They are added along with their measured performance and experience notes on when it works and when it does not. Because every blueprint exposes the same interface, a new blueprint can use any existing one as a component, so the library compounds: early blueprints build on the two foundations, later ones compose from those, and depth grows naturally (Figure 3 a ). Four protocols govern the library (Figure 3 b ): a shared interface, no forward calls, no cycles, and no duplicates.
paragraphs.zh: 蓝图存放在一个随时间不断增长的共享库中。 蓝图在入库时会附带其实测性能记录，以及关于何时有效、何时无效的经验笔记。 由于每个蓝图都暴露相同的接口，新蓝图可以将任何现有蓝图作为组件使用，因此这个库会不断复利增长：早期蓝图构建在两个基础之上，后续蓝图则由这些蓝图组合而成，深度自然增长（图 3 a）。 四条协议约束着这个库（图 3 b）：共享接口、禁止前向调用、禁止循环、禁止重复。

paragraphs.en: Given a task and a small development set, Strategist iteratively retrieves relevant blueprints, proposes K = 5 K{=}5 candidates, evaluates them on real samples, and accumulates the results back into the library (Figure 5 ). After N N iterations, the candidate that beats BL on both the validation and hidden splits by the largest hidden-set margin is returned, or BL itself if none does (Algorithm 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个任务和一个小型开发集，Strategist 迭代地检索相关蓝图，提出 K = 5 K{=}5 个候选方案，在真实样本上评估它们，并将结果累积回蓝图库（图 5）。 在 N N 次迭代之后，返回在验证集和隐藏集划分上均优于 BL 且在隐藏集上优势最大的候选方案；如果没有候选方案满足条件，则返回 BL 本身（算法 1）。

paragraphs.en: The strategist queries the Blueprint Library with a short text prompt. The search is hybrid (TF–IDF plus embedding similarity). Each blueprint carries traits, a measurement card, and experience notes written by previous strategists; the search indexes over all of these, so the strategist finds blueprints by measured behavior and prior analyses, not just structural similarity. Beyond relevant results, the library returns adjacent inspiration (blueprints from other domains or reasoning patterns) to inspire new designs.
paragraphs.zh: 策略智能体用一个简短的文本提示查询蓝图库。 该检索是混合式的（TF–IDF 加上嵌入相似度）。 每个蓝图都带有特征、一张测量卡，以及由先前策略智能体撰写的经验笔记；检索会对所有这些内容建立索引，因此策略智能体可以根据测得的行为和先前的分析来找到蓝图，而不仅仅是结构相似性。 除了相关结果之外，蓝图库还会返回相邻的灵感（来自其他领域或推理模式的蓝图），以激发新的设计。

sents.zh: 策略智能体用一个简短的文本提示查询蓝图库。

paragraphs.en: Using the retrieved blueprints and inspiration, the strategist designs new blueprints or composes from existing ones, each paired with task-specific prompts to form candidate strategies. Each blueprint must be one of three kinds: new (a blueprint with no library backbone), composed (a blueprint that wraps or extends an existing one), or reuse (directly applies an existing library blueprint with new prompts). Every iteration includes at least one candidate of each kind, balancing exploration and exploitation.
paragraphs.zh: 利用检索到的蓝图与灵感，策略设计者（strategist）设计新蓝图，或由现有蓝图组合而成，每张蓝图都配备针对特定任务的提示词，构成候选策略。 每张蓝图必须是三种类型之一：新建（new，即不含库骨干的蓝图）、组合（composed，即包装或扩展现有蓝图），或复用（reuse，即直接应用现有库蓝图并配以新提示词）。 每次迭代都包含至少一个上述每种类型的候选，以平衡探索与利用。

paragraphs.en: The system operates at two levels. At the agent level (inner loop), each candidate strategy processes inputs directly, and the strategist observes the full reasoning trace, execution status, and scores. At the meta level (outer loop), the strategist uses these observations to improve its proposals. The data is split into four parts. The training set : strategies run on these samples and the strategist sees both the scores and the full agent traces. The validation set : strategies also run on these samples, but the strategist sees only the aggregated scores; this mirrors standard train/validation practice and prevents overfitting to the training signal. The hidden set : used to select the winning strategy across all iterations, preventing overfitting to any single iteration. The test set : held out entirely from the search loop and used only for final confirmation.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统在两个层面上运行。 在智能体层面（内循环），每个候选策略直接处理输入，策略生成器可以观察到完整的推理轨迹、执行状态和得分。 在元层面（外循环），策略生成器利用这些观察结果来改进其提议。 数据被划分为四个部分。 训练集：策略在这些样本上运行，策略生成器既能看到得分，也能看到完整的智能体轨迹。 验证集：策略同样在这些样本上运行，但策略生成器只能看到汇总后的得分；这反映了标准的训练/验证做法，可防止对训练信号过拟合。 隐藏集：用于在所有迭代中选出获胜策略，防止对任何单次迭代过拟合。 测试集：完全从搜索循环中隔离出来，仅用于最终确认。

paragraphs.en: The library stores blueprints, not strategies: it retains the reusable structure while discarding task-specific prompts. This is what enables cross-task transfer. After each iteration, the strategist writes an analysis of each candidate’s structural properties and adds the underlying blueprints to the library with their measurement cards and experience notes, with deduplication.
paragraphs.zh: 该库存储的是蓝图，而非策略：它保留可复用的结构，同时丢弃任务特定的提示词。 这正是实现跨任务迁移的原因。 每次迭代后，策略制定者会撰写一份分析，说明每个候选方案的结构属性，并将底层蓝图连同其测量卡和经验笔记（去重后）添加到库中。

paragraphs.en: We compare against 18 baselines (Table 2 ), all using the same task models without internet access. They span from direct prompting to multi-agent workflows, and each runs at all six model configurations, giving 18 × 6 = 108 18\times 6=108 cells per benchmark. Our baseline (BL) is the cell most accurate on a benchmark’s training split, scored on the test set. This mirrors deployment: a method is chosen on the small sample at hand, then applied to a larger unseen sample from the same distribution. Our strategy is likewise chosen without seeing the test set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与18个基线（表2）进行比较，它们都使用相同的任务模型且无法访问互联网。 这些基线涵盖了从直接提示到多智能体工作流的方法，每种方法都在全部六个模型配置下运行，每个基准得到 18 × 6 = 108 个单元格。 我们的基线（BL）是在某个基准的训练集划分上最准确的单元格，并在测试集上进行评分。 这模拟了实际部署：先在手上掌握的小样本上选定方法，然后将其应用于来自同一分布的更大的未见样本。 我们的策略同样是在未接触测试集的情况下选定的。

BL is the cell of the 18 × 6 18\times 6 baseline matrix that is most accurate on the benchmark’s training split; all methods share the same executors, extractor, and 200-sample test split. paragraphs.en: The 30-benchmark main run grew the library to 1,865 1{,}865 blueprints. We test if a future task can skip the full search: on 10 held-out benchmarks, the strategist queries the final strategies of the main searches (not the full library) once, instantiates the top-5 retrieved blueprints for the task, measures each on up to 300 development questions, and runs the chosen one (the most accurate candidate cheaper than BL if within 2 points of the best, otherwise the best) on the test set, with no search. It stays within 2 points of BL’s accuracy on all 10 and above it on 8 ( 77.8 % → 81.4 % 77.8\%\to 81.4\% on average) and wins on 6 (Table 4 ); on BoolQ, SIQA, and DROP it is more accurate but costlier than their very cheap BL ( 1.0 1.0 – 4.9 4.9 k per sample), and on QUALITY it costs 7 % 7\% more at equal accuracy. Its per-benchmark average cost (as in Figure 7 ) is 0.77 × 0.77\times BL’s without BoolQ and SIQA, whose single-call BL puts their ratios at 32 × 32\times and 4.5 × 4.5\times .

paragraphs.en: A strategy is most useful if it captures structure of the task rather than idiosyncrasies of the executor it was searched on. We re-run Strategist -discovered strategies, without any modification to the blueprint code or its prompts, on two model families the strategist never saw during search: OpenAI GPT-5 (nano, mini, full) and Google Gemini-2.5 (flash-lite, flash). On GPT-5 the strategies win on 7 of 10 benchmarks and lose on 3 (ASDiv, HellaSwag, MinervaM: within 2 points of the baseline but costlier); on Gemini they win on 8 of 10, with SQuAD2 and MinervaM mixed (cheaper but less accurate). Aggregate cost in USD drops by 35 % 35\% and 40 % 40\% . Part of the GPT-5 margin comes from baseline workflows that break on the new backend ( self_refine and multi_agent_debate return malformed answers there) while the discovered strategies run unchanged. That a Qwen3-discovered blueprint carries over at all shows that Strategist captures the structure of the task, not executor-specific tricks.
paragraphs.zh: 一种策略若能捕捉任务的结构而非被搜索执行者的特有癖性，才是最有用的。 我们将 Strategist 发现的策略不做任何修改——既不改动蓝图代码也不改动其提示词——直接在两个策略搜索期间从未见过的模型家族上重新运行：OpenAI GPT-5（nano、mini、full）和 Google Gemini-2.5（flash-lite、flash）。 在 GPT-5 上，这些策略在 10 个基准中的 7 个上胜出，在 3 个上落败（ASDiv、HellaSwag、MinervaM：与基线差距在 2 分以内但成本更高）；在 Gemini 上，它们在 10 个中的 8 个上胜出，其中 SQuAD2 和 MinervaM 表现参差（更便宜但准确率更低）。 总成本（以美元计）分别下降 35% 和 40%。 GPT-5 上的部分优势来自基线工作流在新后端上失效（self_refine 和 multi_agent_debate 在那里返回格式错误的答案），而发现的策略则无需改动即可运行。 Qwen3 发现的蓝图竟然能够迁移，这本身就表明 Strategist 捕捉的是任务的结构，而非执行者特有的技巧。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows one strategy (accuracy driven) designed for the Amazon-Rec task: it builds a user profile with cheap calls, extracts brand and category signals, and conditionally routes to a multi-agent debate only for users with shifting preferences, before merging and auditing the top picks. The branching is cheap deterministic logic that decides which inputs deserve the expensive call, so the strategy spends its capacity where it actually changes the answer rather than uniformly across all inputs. The conditional routing, the merge weighting, and the audit step all emerged from iterative proposals against measured accuracy. Because the result is plain Python, a user can read and edit it directly, and the call is structural, which is hard to do with prompt-bag methods or training-based alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了一个为 Amazon-Rec 任务设计的策略（准确率驱动）：它先用低成本的调用构建用户画像，提取品牌和品类信号，并仅对偏好发生变化的用户有条件地路由到多智能体辩论，然后合并并审计排名靠前的推荐结果。 这种分支是低成本的确定性逻辑，用于决定哪些输入值得进行昂贵的调用，因此策略把它的算力花在真正会改变答案的地方，而不是均匀地分配到所有输入上。 有条件的路由、合并时的权重分配以及审计步骤，都是在针对实测准确率进行迭代提议的过程中产生的。 由于结果是纯 Python 代码，用户可以直接阅读和编辑它，而且调用是结构化的，这一点是提示词堆砌方法或基于训练的替代方案难以做到的。

paragraphs.en: The strategist sees training traces and validation scores at every iteration and could fit noise in them; if it did, the training curve would pull away from the hidden curve. Figure 9 plots, per iteration, the mean accuracy of that iteration’s five candidates on each split, averaged over the 30 main benchmarks. The curves move together and the training–hidden gap stays between 1.2 1.2 and 2.5 2.5 points, so the proposals do not drift away from data the strategist never sees. Selection is a different matter: the final strategy is chosen for being best on the hidden split, and part of that is luck. Across the 30 benchmarks the pick is 4.3 4.3 points above BL on hidden but 0.7 0.7 on test (BL itself moves by 0.5 0.5 ). paragraphs.en: Structure-search methods write strategies as raw code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) or compose them from fixed components or predefined modules ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; the first yields isolated programs, the second bounds what can be discovered. Optimization methods refine one strategy per task, by reinforcement learning ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) or by LLM-driven evolution and refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , and start over on the next task. Routing methods select among existing strategies without building them ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Strategist instead allows freeform creation via the Strategy Blueprint, needs no training, builds strategies itself, and routes across model tiers in each strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 结构搜索方法将策略写成原始代码（Hu et al., 2025），或从固定组件或预定义模块中组合策略（Zhang et al., 2025c；Shang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）；前者产生孤立的程序，后者限制了可发现的内容。 优化方法针对每个任务精炼单一策略，方式包括强化学习（Li et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2025）或由大语言模型驱动的进化与精炼（Gao et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025a），并且在下一个任务上从头开始。 路由方法在现有策略中进行选择而不构建策略（Taparia et al., 2026；Yue et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025b）。 Strategist 则允许通过策略蓝图进行自由式创建，无需训练，自行构建策略，并在每个策略内跨模型层级进行路由。

paragraphs.en: Cross-task transfer has been studied through meta-learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Hospedales et al., 2022 ) , neural architecture search ( Elsken et al., 2019 ) , and prompt optimization ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; in the LLM-agent setting, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) accumulate experience or skills, and lifelong-agent learning has been formalized as a direction ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Existing automated design methods ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) still largely optimize per task. Strategist maintains a shared blueprint library that grows with every task, providing both exploitation (relevant components) and exploration (diverse inspiration); to our knowledge, the first automated strategy-design system that accumulates knowledge from one task to the next.

paragraphs.en: We presented Strategist , a meta-agent that designs inference strategies as freeform executable programs on a layered framework, the Strategy Blueprint, and grows a shared Blueprint Library across tasks. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist -designed strategies match or beat most strongest baselines on accuracy while running at substantially lower cost, and the discovered strategies transfer to backends the strategist never searched on. We view freeform strategy design over an accumulating library as a step toward inference systems that get better the more they are used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Strategist，一个元智能体，它在分层框架——策略蓝图（Strategy Blueprint）之上将推理策略设计为自由格式的可执行程序，并跨任务构建一个共享的蓝图库。 在 30 个基准测试上，Strategist 所设计的策略在准确率上持平或超越大多数最强基线，同时运行成本显著更低，并且所发现的策略能够迁移到该智能体从未搜索过的后端上。 我们将基于不断积累的蓝图库的自由格式策略设计视为迈向越用越好推理系统的一步。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 formalizes the four-stage iterative pipeline described in Section 3 . Inputs are a task description 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , a development set D D split into feedback/validation/hidden subsets, the current shared blueprint library ℒ \mathcal{L} , and the number of iterations N N . Each iteration runs four steps: (i) the strategist queries ℒ \mathcal{L} for the most relevant blueprints and a set of adjacent-domain inspirations; (ii) the strategist proposes K K candidate strategies, balanced across the kinds new / composed / reuse and the targets accuracy / efficiency / balanced ; (iii) each candidate is executed on D D and scored on accuracy and cost; (iv) the strategist writes experience notes summarizing what worked and what failed, and the candidates plus their measurement cards are written back to ℒ \mathcal{L} with structural deduplication. The reference baseline b b (the baseline cell most accurate on the training split, run with its exact code) is evaluated alongside the candidates in the first iteration. After N N iterations, every candidate is compared with b b question by question on the validation and hidden splits; among the candidates that beat b b under the 2% rule on both (better by more than 2 points in accuracy or 2% in cost, worse on neither), the one with the largest hidden-set accuracy gain is returned as s ∗ s^{*} , and b b itself if none qualifies. The updated library ℒ ′ \mathcal{L}^{\prime} is carried forward for future tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 对第 3 节所述的四阶段迭代流程进行了形式化。 输入包括任务描述 𝒯、划分为反馈/验证/隐藏子集的开发集 D、当前共享蓝图库 ℒ，以及迭代次数 N。 每次迭代运行四个步骤：(i) 策略师查询 ℒ 以获取最相关的蓝图和一组相邻领域的灵感；(ii) 策略师提出 K 个候选策略，在新/组合/复用这几类与准确率/效率/均衡这几类目标之间保持均衡；(iii) 每个候选在 D 上执行，并按准确率和成本打分；(iv) 策略师撰写经验笔记，总结哪些有效、哪些失败，并将候选及其度量卡片经结构化去重后写回 ℒ。 参考基线 b（在训练子集上准确率最高的基线单元格，以其确切代码运行）在第一次迭代中与候选一起被评估。 在 N 次迭代之后，每个候选在验证和隐藏子集上与 b 逐题比较；在依据 2% 规则（准确率高出 2 分以上或成本低 2% 以上，且两项均不更差）在两个子集上都击败 b 的候选中，返回隐藏集准确率提升最大的那个作为 s*，若无合格者则返回 b 本身。 更新后的库 ℒ′ 将被延续用于后续任务。

paragraphs.en: All strategies and baselines run as 0-shot generation: the executor LLM produces a free-form response and an answer extractor parses the final answer from the trace. The extractor is benchmark-aware (multiple-choice letter, integer, LaTeX numeric, span, or yes/no) and is the same across Strategist , all baselines, and all five comparison frameworks, so reported accuracy differences reflect strategy choices rather than scoring asymmetries.
paragraphs.zh: 所有策略与基线均以 0-shot 生成的形式运行：执行者 LLM 生成自由格式的回复，再由答案抽取器从轨迹中解析出最终答案。 该抽取器是面向基准的（支持多项选择字母、整数、LaTeX 数值、文本片段或是否题），并且在 Strategist、所有基线以及全部五个对比框架中保持一致，因此所报告的准确率差异反映的是策略选择的不同，而非评分机制的不对称。

paragraphs.en: Mathematical reasoning: GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) (grade-school word problems, numeric), MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) (competition math, LaTeX/numeric), AQuA-RAT ( Ling et al., 2017 ) (algebra, 5 choices), AIME 2024 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2024 ) (American Invitational Math, 30 problems, integer 0–999), ASDiv ( Miao et al., 2020 ) (diverse word problems, numeric), SVAMP ( Patel et al., 2021 ) (perturbed word problems, numeric), MinervaMath ( Lewkowycz et al., 2022 ) (graduate-level quantitative, LaTeX/numeric), Gaokao-Math-QA ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) (Chinese college-entrance MCQ, 4 choices).
paragraphs.zh: 数学推理：GSM8K（Cobbe et al., 2021）（小学应用题，数值型）、MATH500（Hendrycks et al., 2021b）（竞赛数学，LaTeX/数值型）、AQuA-RAT（Ling et al., 2017）（代数，5 个选项）、AIME 2024（Mathematical Association of America, 2024）（美国数学邀请赛，30 道题，整数 0–999）、ASDiv（Miao et al., 2020）（多样化应用题，数值型）、SVAMP（Patel et al., 2021）（扰动应用题，数值型）、MinervaMath（Lewkowycz et al., 2022）（研究生级别的定量题，LaTeX/数值型）、Gaokao-Math-QA（Zhong et al., 2024）（中国高考选择题，4 个选项）。

paragraphs.en: Code generation: MBPP+ ( Liu et al., 2023 ) (Python function synthesis, pass@1 on extra-test variant of MBPP).

paragraphs.en: Commonsense reasoning: HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) (sentence completion, 4 choices), PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) (physical commonsense, 2 choices), Social IQa ( Sap et al., 2019 ) (social commonsense, 3 choices), WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ) (coreference, 2 choices), CommonsenseQA ( Talmor et al., 2019 ) (general commonsense, 5 choices), COPA ( Roemmele et al., 2011 ) (causal alternatives, 2 choices), OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) (elementary science, 4 choices), SciQ ( Welbl et al., 2017 ) (crowdsourced science, 4 choices), StrategyQA ( Geva et al., 2021 ) (implicit-reasoning yes/no), BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) (passage-grounded yes/no).

paragraphs.en: Knowledge and QA: MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) (57 subjects, 4 choices), MMLU-STEM-Hard (filtered hard STEM subset, 4 choices), TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) (closed-book trivia, EM), NQ-Open ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) (closed-book Wikipedia QA, EM), TruthfulQA ( Lin et al., 2022 ) (misconception-resistant MC1), SQuAD v2 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) (extractive with unanswerables, F1).
paragraphs.zh: 知识与问答：MMLU（Hendrycks et al., 2021a）（57 个学科，4 个选项）、MMLU-STEM-Hard（筛选出的高难度 STEM 子集，4 个选项）、TriviaQA（Joshi et al., 2017）（闭卷知识问答，EM）、NQ-Open（Kwiatkowski et al., 2019）（基于维基百科的闭卷问答，EM）、TruthfulQA（Lin et al., 2022）（抗错误认知的 MC1）、SQuAD v2（Rajpurkar et al., 2018）（抽取式问答，包含不可回答问题，F1）。

paragraphs.en: Logical and analytical reasoning: BBH ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ) (23 BIG-Bench Hard tasks, mixed format), ANLI-R3 ( Nie et al., 2020 ) (round-3 adversarial NLI, 3 choices), ReClor ( Yu et al., 2020 ) (logical reading comprehension, 4 choices), AGIEval English MCQ ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) : SAT-Math, SAT-EN, LSAT-AR, LSAT-LR, LSAT-RC (4–5 choices each), MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) (USMLE-style, 4 choices).
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑与分析推理：BBH（Suzgun et al., 2023）（23 个 BIG-Bench Hard 任务，混合格式）、ANLI-R3（Nie et al., 2020）（第 3 轮对抗性 NLI，3 个选项）、ReClor（Yu et al., 2020）（逻辑阅读理解，4 个选项）、AGIEval 英文选择题（Zhong et al., 2024）：SAT-Math、SAT-EN、LSAT-AR、LSAT-LR、LSAT-RC（各 4–5 个选项）、MedQA（Jin et al., 2021）（USMLE 风格，4 个选项）。

paragraphs.en: Recommendation: Amazon-Rec ( Liu et al., 2025b ) (rank top item from a candidate pool, hit-rate).
paragraphs.zh: 推荐：Amazon-Rec（Liu et al., 2025b）（从候选池中对物品进行排序，命中率）。

paragraphs.en: We compare against 18 18 standard baselines covering both single-call prompting and full agentic systems. Each baseline is evaluated on every one of the six tier/mode configurations, giving an 18 × 6 = 108 18\times 6=108 -cell baseline matrix per benchmark. The matrix is measured on both the training split and the test set; the cell most accurate on the training split is BL, and its test result is reported.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与18个标准基线进行比较，这些基线涵盖单次调用提示和完整的智能体系统。 每个基线都在全部六个层级/模式配置上进行评估，从而在每个基准测试中得到一个 18 × 6 = 108 的基线矩阵。 该矩阵在训练集划分和测试集上均进行测量；在训练集划分上最准确的是 BL，并报告其在测试集上的结果。

paragraphs.en: direct: a single LLM call that returns the answer with no intermediate reasoning. The minimum-cost baseline; serves as the floor for comparisons on easy benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: direct：单次调用 LLM 直接返回答案，中间不进行推理。 成本最低的基线；作为简单基准上对比的下限。

sents.en: direct: a single LLM call that returns the answer with no intermediate reasoning.
sents.zh: direct：单次调用 LLM 直接返回答案，中间不进行推理。

sents.en: The minimum-cost baseline; serves as the floor for comparisons on easy benchmarks.
sents.zh: 成本最低的基线；作为简单基准上对比的下限。

paragraphs.en: chain-of-thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) : a single call prompted with “Let’s think step by step”, encouraging the model to emit intermediate reasoning before the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链（chain-of-thought，CoT）（Wei et al., 2022）：单次调用，通过提示词“Let's think step by step”鼓励模型在给出最终答案之前先输出中间推理步骤。

paragraphs.en: self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) : sample 3 3 CoT trajectories at temperature 0.7 0.7 and return the majority-voted final answer; trades cost for variance reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 自洽性（self-consistency，Wang et al., 2023）：在温度 0.7 下采样 3 条 CoT 轨迹，并返回多数投票后的最终答案；以成本换取方差的降低。

paragraphs.en: direct-thinking: a single call in thinking mode with no extra prompting, isolating the contribution of the model’s hidden reasoning trace from any prompting trick.
paragraphs.zh: direct-thinking：在思考模式下进行单次调用，不附加任何额外提示，从而将模型隐藏推理痕迹的贡献与任何提示技巧隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: tree-of-thoughts (ToT) ( Yao et al., 2023a ) : maintain a tree of partial reasoning states, expand each by sampling a few continuations, score with the model itself, and search BFS-style for a high-scoring leaf.
paragraphs.zh: 思维树（ToT）（Yao et al., 2023a）：维护一棵由部分推理状态构成的树，通过采样若干续写来扩展每个状态，用模型自身进行评分，并以广度优先搜索的方式搜索高评分的叶子节点。

paragraphs.en: least-to-most ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) : a first call decomposes the question into sub-problems; subsequent calls solve them in order, each conditioned on prior answers.
paragraphs.zh: least-to-most（Zhou et al., 2023）：第一次调用将问题分解为若干子问题；后续调用按顺序解决它们，每次调用都依赖于先前的答案。

paragraphs.en: chain-of-verification (CoVe) ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) : produce a draft answer, generate verification questions about it, answer those independently, and revise if any verification disagrees.
paragraphs.zh: 验证链（chain-of-verification, CoVe）（Dhuliawala et al., 2024）：先生成一个初步答案，然后针对该答案生成验证问题，独立回答这些问题，若任何验证结果不一致则进行修订。

paragraphs.en: self-discover ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) : the model first selects and composes a custom reasoning structure (decomposition, verification, etc.) from a fixed pool, then applies that structure to the input.
paragraphs.zh: self-discover (Zhou et al., 2024)：模型首先从一个固定的候选池中选择并组合自定义的推理结构（分解、验证等），然后将该结构应用于输入。

paragraphs.en: self-refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) : a feedback-and-revise loop in which the model critiques its own draft and rewrites it; we cap the loop at three rounds.
paragraphs.zh: self-refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 )：一种反馈-修订循环，模型对自身草稿进行批评并重写；我们将该循环限制为三轮。

paragraphs.en: vanilla-agent: an OpenHands ReAct loop with the TerminalTool and FileEditorTool only, no extra prompt scaffolding.
paragraphs.zh: vanilla-agent：一个仅包含 TerminalTool 和 FileEditorTool 的 OpenHands ReAct 循环，没有额外的提示脚手架。

paragraphs.en: agent-code: the same agent but the prompt instructs the model to write and execute Python via the terminal tool, so numeric/code-heavy steps are grounded in actual computation.
paragraphs.zh: agent-code：同一个智能体，但提示词指示模型通过终端工具编写并执行 Python，因此涉及数值/代码较多的步骤都以实际计算为依据。

paragraphs.en: multi-agent-debate ( Du et al., 2024 ) : 3 3 agents propose answers, then in 2 2 subsequent rounds each agent sees the others’ answers and revises; the final majority vote is returned.
paragraphs.zh: multi-agent-debate（Du et al., 2024）：3 个智能体提出答案，随后在 2 轮中每个智能体看到其他智能体的答案并进行修改；最终返回多数投票结果。

paragraphs.en: MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) : a role-based pipeline (planner, executor, reviewer) that hands a structured artifact between roles; we use the open-source role prompts unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) ：一种基于角色的流水线（规划者、执行者、审查者），在角色之间传递结构化产物；我们原封不动地使用其开源的角色提示词。

paragraphs.en: AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2023 ) : a two-agent conversable setup (assistant + user-proxy with tool-use) that converses until the assistant emits a termination signal.
paragraphs.zh: AutoGen (Wu et al., 2023)：一个双智能体可对话设置（助手 + 具有工具使用能力的用户代理），双方持续对话直到助手发出终止信号。

paragraphs.en: chain-of-agents (CoA) ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) : a chain of worker agents each summarises a slice of the input and passes a hand-off message to the next; a final manager agent answers from the chain.
paragraphs.zh: chain-of-agents（智能体链，CoA）（Zhang et al., 2024）：由多个工作智能体组成的链，每个智能体对输入的一个片段进行总结，并将交接消息传递给下一个智能体；最后一个管理者智能体根据该链给出答案。

paragraphs.en: reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) : an outer loop that, on failure, asks the model to write a verbal self-reflection and retries with the reflection appended to the next prompt.
paragraphs.zh: reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 )：一个外层循环，在失败时要求模型撰写语言化的自我反思，并将该反思附加到下一次提示后进行重试。

paragraphs.en: monte-carlo-vote / shortlist-vote: two self-consistency variants—the first samples 5 5 traces and returns the strict majority (resampling on a tie), the second pre-filters to a top- 10 10 shortlist before a 3 3 -way vote—used to test whether voting beyond the standard 3 3 samples helps.
paragraphs.zh: monte-carlo-vote / shortlist-vote：两种自洽性变体——第一种采样 5 5 条轨迹并返回严格多数结果（平票时重新采样），第二种先预筛选出前 10 10 名的短名单，再进行 3 3 方投票——用于测试超出标准 3 3 个样本的投票是否有帮助。

paragraphs.en: All baselines run on the same Qwen3 executors and the same OpenHands tool sandbox ( TerminalTool + FileEditorTool only) with no internet access, identical to Strategist strategies. Each baseline is evaluated independently at every one of the six tier/mode configurations, but baselines do not internally route across tiers within a single run; the ability to mix tiers within one strategy is part of the design space Strategist searches over, and BL is the single-config cell most accurate on the training split.
paragraphs.zh: 所有基线均运行在相同的 Qwen3 执行器和相同的 OpenHands 工具沙箱（仅含 TerminalTool 和 FileEditorTool）上，无法访问互联网，与 Strategist 策略完全一致。 每个基线都在全部六个层级/模式配置上独立评估，但基线在单次运行内部不会跨层级进行路由；在单个策略内混合使用层级的能力属于 Strategist 搜索的设计空间的一部分，而 BL 是在训练集划分上最准确的单配置单元。

paragraphs.en: Every benchmark is partitioned into four disjoint subsets: training , validation , hidden , and test . The training set is what the strategist sees in full, including per-sample reasoning traces, when proposing the next iteration’s slate. The validation set is also evaluated each iteration but only aggregate scores are visible, mirroring standard train/val practice. The validation and hidden sets are used to pick the final strategy across all N N iterations (Algorithm 1 ); the hidden set is never shown to the strategist; in particular, experience notes written back to the library are derived from training-set traces only, so hidden-set signal cannot leak across iterations or to future tasks. The test set is held out from the search loop entirely and is used only for the final number reported in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 每个基准都被划分为四个互不相交的子集：训练集、验证集、隐藏集和测试集。 在提出下一轮迭代方案时，智能体可以看到训练集的全部内容，包括每个样本的推理轨迹。 验证集也会在每轮迭代中被评估，但只显示聚合分数，这与标准的训练/验证实践一致。 验证集和隐藏集用于在全部 N 次迭代中选出最终策略（算法 1）；隐藏集从不对智能体展示；特别地，写回库中的经验笔记仅来自训练集的轨迹，因此隐藏集的信号不会跨迭代泄露，也不会泄露给未来的任务。 测试集被完全排除在搜索循环之外，仅用于报告正文中的最终结果。

paragraphs.en: The development rows of each benchmark come from a separate development pool (300 rows where available), drawn deterministically with a fixed seed and split into training, validation, and hidden sets of 100 100 rows each; benchmarks with smaller pools scale all three down proportionally, and AIME 2024 and Amazon-Rec, whose questions are about 10 × 10\times longer to solve, use 50 50 rows per split. Where a benchmark’s own pool was too small, it was extended: COPA and SVAMP with rows from their official training data, and AIME with the 299 problems of AIME 2014–2023. The test set is around the first 200 200 rows of each benchmark’s test file, disjoint from all development rows and never seen during search. Six benchmarks have fewer questions due to limit data. Splits are deterministic, so reruns and ablations operate identically.
paragraphs.zh: 每个基准的开发集行来自一个独立的开发池（在可用时为 300 行），以固定种子确定性地抽取，并划分为训练、验证和隐藏集，各 100 行；数据池较小的基准按比例缩减这三部分的规模，而 AIME 2024 和 Amazon-Rec 因其问题求解耗时约长 10 倍，每个划分只使用 50 行。 当基准自身的数据池过小时，会对其进行扩充：COPA 和 SVAMP 使用其官方训练数据中的行补充，AIME 则补充 AIME 2014–2023 的 299 道题目。 测试集为每个基准测试文件的前约 200 行，与所有开发集行不相交，且在搜索过程中从未被见过。 由于数据有限，六个基准的问题数量较少。 各划分是确定性的，因此重复运行和消融实验的操作完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Each iteration proposes K = 5 K=5 candidate strategies; the search runs for N = 10 N=10 iterations per benchmark. Every iteration must include at least one candidate of each kind ( new , composed , reuse ) and of each target ( accuracy : beat BL’s accuracy within its cost; efficiency : hold its accuracy at lower cost; balanced ); slates that violate this rule, deduplicate a recent candidate, or omit required JSON fields are rejected and the strategist is re-prompted. The strategist is shown the baseline matrix measured on the training split (every baseline at all six configurations, with BL highlighted) and the 2% rule by which candidates are judged; it keeps one session across iterations, so later iterations send only the new results. Each LLM call from a strategy uses max_tokens=16384 . A full search evaluates about 60 candidates per benchmark ( K = 5 K{=}5 per iteration plus the reference and repairs), each on all three development splits, roughly 20,000 20{,}000 candidate-sample executions for a benchmark with 100 100 rows per split, plus about 135 135 k prompt tokens and 45 45 k response tokens for the strategist (about 10 10 k prompt tokens per iteration), so the search dominates the per-task cost and amortises across future tasks via library reuse (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每次迭代提出 K=5 个候选策略；每项基准测试的搜索运行 N=10 次迭代。 每次迭代必须至少包含每种类型（new、composed、reuse）各一个候选，以及每种目标（accuracy：在成本范围内超越 BL 的准确率；efficiency：以更低成本保持其准确率；balanced）各一个候选；违反此规则、重复最近候选或遗漏必需 JSON 字段的候选集将被拒绝，并重新提示策略制定者。 策略制定者会看到在训练集上测得的基线矩阵（所有基线在全部六种配置下的结果，并高亮显示 BL）以及用于评判候选的 2% 规则；它在各次迭代间保持同一个会话，因此后续迭代只发送新的结果。 策略的每次 LLM 调用使用 max_tokens=16384。 一次完整搜索每项基准测试评估约 60 个候选（每次迭代 K=5 个，加上参考和修复），每个候选在全部三个开发集上运行；对于每个开发集有 100 行的基准测试，大约执行 20,000 次候选样本运行；此外策略制定者约消耗 135k 提示词元和 45k 响应词元（每次迭代约 10k 提示词元）；因此搜索在每项任务成本中占主导，并可通过库的复用在未来的任务间摊销（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Two blueprints are considered duplicates if their execute function bodies hash to the same value after task-specific string literals (prompts, format instructions) are elided; this is computed over the Python AST so that whitespace and comment changes do not produce spurious distinctions. Duplicate proposals are rejected at submission time and not added to the library.

paragraphs.en: Each iteration the strategist returns Python code (the candidate strategies) followed by a JSON block describing the slate. The JSON has six required fields per candidate ( name , kind , target , tier_mode_anchors , why , builds_on ) and an optional prompts field that replaces a blueprint’s prompt texts for this task, plus three search-side fields ( search_queries , read_cards , experience ). A non-fatal AST audit checks that builds_on matches the imports in the code block; warnings are fed into the next iteration’s prompt rather than killing the run.
paragraphs.zh: 每一轮迭代中，策略者都会返回 Python 代码（即候选策略），其后附带一个描述策略清单的 JSON 块。 该 JSON 对每个候选包含六个必填字段（name、kind、target、tier_mode_anchors、why、builds_on），以及一个可选的 prompts 字段（用于替换蓝图在该任务中的提示文本），另有三个搜索侧字段（search_queries、read_cards、experience）。 一次非致命的 AST 审计会检查 builds_on 是否与代码块中的导入相匹配；警告会反馈到下一轮迭代的提示中，而不是终止整个运行。

paragraphs.en: At each iteration the strategist issues two textual queries against the library: a relevance query summarising what the current task is asking for, and an inspiration query phrased to deliberately drift from the task description (e.g., asking for “multi-path verification on long-context QA” when the task itself is short-form math). Each query is scored by a hybrid function s = α ​ s tfidf + ( 1 − α ) ​ s emb s=\alpha\,s_{\text{tfidf}}+(1-\alpha)\,s_{\text{emb}} over every blueprint’s index entry, where s tfidf s_{\text{tfidf}} is computed over the blueprint name, one-line description, when-to-use field, and trait tags, and s emb s_{\text{emb}} is the cosine similarity between the query and a sentence-transformer ( all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ) embedding of the blueprint’s measurement card and experience notes; we use α = 0.4 \alpha=0.4 throughout. Each query returns its top- 5 5 blueprints, deduplicated against blueprints already returned by the relevance query so the inspiration slate cannot overlap. The strategist sees a total of 10 10 blueprints per iteration (5 relevance hits with their measurement cards rendered in full, 5 adjacent inspirations with only the one-line description shown) and is asked, in the prompt, to use the relevance hits as composition or reuse candidates and the inspiration hits as material for new blueprints.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次迭代中，策略者会向库发出两个文本查询：一个是相关性查询，用于总结当前任务的需求；另一个是灵感查询，其措辞刻意偏离任务描述（例如，当任务本身是简短的数学题时，却请求“长上下文问答的多路径验证”）。 每个查询通过混合函数 s = α s_tfidf + (1 − α) s_emb 对每个蓝图的索引条目进行评分，其中 s_tfidf 基于蓝图名称、单行描述、使用时机字段和特征标签计算，而 s_emb 是查询与蓝图度量卡和经验笔记的句子转换器（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）嵌入之间的余弦相似度；我们在全文中统一使用 α = 0.4。 每个查询返回其排名前 5 的蓝图，并与相关性查询已返回的蓝图去重，以确保灵感列表不会与之重叠。 策略者在每次迭代中总共看到 10 个蓝图（5 个相关性命中项，其度量卡完整呈现；5 个相邻灵感项，仅显示单行描述），并在提示中被要求将相关性命中项用作组合或复用候选，将灵感命中项用作创建新蓝图的素材。

paragraphs.en: The strategy runs a library multi-hop blueprint and then guards one failure mode: a count answered as a digit when the passages spell it as a word. It asks a 1.7B model to spell the number, accepts the word only if it occurs in the context and an independent call decodes it back to the same number, and otherwise keeps the digit. On MuSiQue it scores 42.0% against BL’s 41.0% at 0.93 × \times the cost.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略运行一个库式多跳蓝图，然后针对一种失败模式进行防护：当语料把数字拼写为单词时，答案却以数字形式给出。 它让一个 1.7B 模型把该数字拼写出来，只有当这个单词出现在上下文中、并且一次独立调用又能把它解码回同一个数字时，才采用该单词形式，否则保留数字形式。 在 MuSiQue 上，它的得分为 42.0%，而 BL 为 41.0%，成本是其 0.93 × \times 倍。

paragraphs.en: Two parallel complex/nothink calls copy verbatim spans from the problem, one for what is asked and one for counting scope and units; spans that do not occur in the problem are dropped. paragraphs.zh: 两个并行的复杂/无思考（nothink）调用逐字复制问题中的片段，一个用于提取所问内容，另一个用于确定范围和单位；不在问题中出现的片段将被丢弃。 随后由单次复杂/思考（thinking）调用以这些片段作为注意力引导来求解原始问题。 在 GSM8K 上，它取得 92.0% 的得分，而 BL 为 94.0%，成本仅为后者的 0.13 × \times 倍。

paragraphs.en: Large language models have rapidly evolved from single-call question answerers into multi-step agent systems. Chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and self-consistency decoding ( Wang et al., 2023 ) showed that intermediate reasoning steps improve accuracy on complex tasks. Tree of Thoughts ( Yao et al., 2023a ) extended this to deliberate search over reasoning paths. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023b ) interleaved reasoning with tool use, and Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) taught models to call external APIs autonomously. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) introduced verbal self-reflection as a feedback mechanism. Multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2023 ) enabled conversational collaboration among multiple LLM agents. Formal representations for these systems range from state machines ( Wu et al., 2024 ) to declarative compilation ( Khattab et al., 2024 ) to optimizable computational graphs ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . A recent survey ( Yue et al., 2026 ) organizes this landscape as agentic computation graphs, distinguishing static, pre-execution, and in-execution optimization. As these systems grow more complex, the strategy layer that determines how models are called, in what order, and with what verification has become the central design bottleneck. Strategist addresses this bottleneck by automating the design of the strategy layer itself.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型已从单次调用的问题回答者迅速演变为多步骤的智能体系统。 思维链提示（Wei et al., 2022）和自洽性解码（Wang et al., 2023）表明，中间推理步骤能够提高复杂任务上的准确率。 思维树（Yao et al., 2023a）将其扩展为对推理路径的审慎搜索。 ReAct（Yao et al., 2023b）将推理与工具使用交织进行，而 Toolformer（Schick et al., 2023）则教会模型自主调用外部 API。 Reflexion（Shinn et al., 2023）引入了语言化的自我反思作为反馈机制。 AutoGen（Wu et al., 2023）等多智能体框架使多个大语言模型智能体之间能够以对话方式进行协作。 对这些系统的形式化表示涵盖从状态机（Wu et al., 2024）到声明式编译（Khattab et al., 2024）再到可优化的计算图（Zhuge et al., 2024）。 近期的一项综述（Yue et al., 2026）将这一领域组织为智能体计算图，区分了静态优化、执行前优化和执行中优化。 随着这些系统日益复杂，决定模型以何种顺序、采用何种验证方式被调用的策略层，已成为核心的设计瓶颈。 Strategist 通过自动化策略层本身的设计来应对这一瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Structure search methods write strategies as raw code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) or compose them from fixed components ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) or predefined modules ( Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; the first yields isolated programs, the second bounds what strategies can be discovered. Optimization methods refine one strategy per task, by reinforcement learning ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) or by LLM-driven evolution and refinement ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , and start over on the next task. Routing methods train controllers to select among existing strategies ( Taparia et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) without constructing them ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Strategist differs by allowing freeform creation through the Strategy Blueprint, requiring no training, constructing strategies itself, and routing across model tiers within each strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 结构搜索方法将策略写成原始代码（Hu et al., 2025），或由固定组件（Zhang et al., 2025c）或预定义模块（Shang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）组合而成；前者产生孤立的程序，后者限制了可发现的策略范围。 优化方法针对每个任务精炼单一策略，方式包括强化学习（Li et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2025）或由大语言模型驱动的演化与精炼（Gao et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025a），并在下一个任务上重新开始。 路由方法训练控制器在现有策略中进行选择（Taparia et al., 2026；Yue et al., 2025），而不构建策略（Zhang et al., 2025b）。 Strategist 的不同之处在于：通过策略蓝图实现自由形式的创建，无需训练，自行构建策略，并在每个策略内部跨模型层级进行路由。

paragraphs.en: Transferring knowledge across tasks has been studied through meta-learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Hospedales et al., 2022 ) , neural architecture search ( Elsken et al., 2019 ) , and prompt optimization ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . In the LLM agent setting, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) extracts reusable insights from agent experiences, Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) grows a skill library as it explores new environments, and recent work has formalized this direction as lifelong learning for LLM agents ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Despite this, automated system design methods ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) still optimize per task independently. Strategist maintains a shared library of blueprints and their measured properties that grows with every task, providing both relevant components (exploitation) and diverse inspiration from other tasks (exploration). To our knowledge, it is the first system for automated strategy design that accumulates knowledge across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 跨任务的知识迁移已经通过元学习（Finn et al., 2017；Hospedales et al., 2022）、神经架构搜索（Elsken et al., 2019）以及提示词优化（Yang et al., 2024）得到了研究。 在大语言模型智能体的设定下，ExpeL（Zhao et al., 2024）从智能体经验中提取可复用的洞见，Voyager（Wang et al., 2024）在探索新环境的过程中不断扩充技能库，而最近的工作已将这一方向形式化为大语言模型智能体的终身学习（Zheng et al., 2025）。 尽管如此，自动化系统设计方法（Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c）仍然针对每个任务独立地进行优化。 Strategist 维护一个共享的蓝图库及其度量属性，该库随着每个任务而不断增长，既提供相关组件（利用），也提供来自其他任务的多样化灵感（探索）。 据我们所知，这是首个能够跨任务积累知识的自动化策略设计系统。
